user_prompt: What is the effect of personalised (tailored or adapted to a subgroup) parenting or family interventions, compared with the standard non-personalised version of the same intervention, on child conduct problems in children with conduct problems, measured on the Eyberg Child Behavior Inventory (ECBI) Problem scale at the end of treatment?  Pool as a mean difference (MD) in ECBI Problem scale points, random effects. MD < 0 favours the personalised intervention.  Extract the post-treatment mean, SD and n per arm for the ECBI Problem scale (not the Intensity scale), from the first assessment after treatment ended. Use the mother's report if several reporters are given. Convert SE to SD where needed. Use only randomised trials in which the control arm is a non-personalised active intervention, not a waitlist or usual care. Do not pool follow-up assessments, the Intensity scale, other behaviour scales or parent outcomes.
